title: [MTR4] CFR Eurofima Carriages Plus (+)
description: Extension on Soodari's Eurofima Pack for CFR
body:
# **[MTR 4 Only]**
Romania Mentioned Again!?!?

Have you ever wanted more CFR wagons for MTR? Well look no further to this pack!

Its just fictional CFR eurofima Carriages.

This is a continuation of [Soodari's Eurofima Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mtr34srt_european_continental_trains) with PNRR wagons and different variants being made. Please use the the base from it to use this pack.
